codex-gpt-6.1-sol-v1:c0d88010c0a3e17dabc.title: The typical winner is nearly done in a week. The average one never stops.

codex-gpt-6.1-sol-v1:e881d8afae96cb6a6f8.title: Which exit is best depends on what you are solving for.
codex-gpt-6.1-sol-v1:e881d8afae96cb6a6f8.description_ko: 돌파 매수 829건에 네 가지 청산 방식을 적용해 거래당 수익, 최대 낙폭, 승률을 비교한 차트. 20일 추적 청산은 수익이, 3일 차 절반 매도는 낙폭과 승률이 가장 유리하게 표시된다.

codex-gpt-6.1-sol-v1:96e1c3612bb8b3f4197.title: Take away the big movers and the ranking inverts.

codex-gpt-6.1-sol-v1:20741216058c7484513.title: Raising your stop too soon costs you the winners.

codex-gpt-6.1-sol-v1:c094a4b071e36b2b3d3.title: Most of the time, the sell rule never gets to fire.
